license_note: Physical dimensions and electrical ratings are facts published by each maker (PerfectFlite, Missile Works, Featherweight Altimeters, Eggtimer Rocketry, Altus Metrum) in their product manuals; the Altus Metrum manual is open-source (AltOS documentation, GPL) and was read directly; battery dimensions are IEC 60086 / ANSI C18 standard envelopes, Ultralife/Energizer/Panasonic datasheets and LiPo pouch size codes. No proprietary content reproduced. Every row's confidence is the LOWEST confidence of any numeric field in it; per-field confidence for altimeters is in outline_confidence / hole_confidence. No altimeter hole pattern in this table is verified.

columns.kind: 'altimeter' or 'battery'. EVERY row carries EVERY column; a column that does not apply to the row's kind is null (never absent). Consumers branch on kind.
columns.model: altimeter: model name / hardware revision assumed
columns.superseded_by: altimeter: current-production replacement if the named model is no longer sold; null if still sold or unknown
columns.name: battery: common name (null for altimeter)
columns.pcb_l_in: altimeter: PCB length exactly as the maker states it, inches; null if maker specifies metric or unknown
columns.pcb_w_in: altimeter: PCB width exactly as the maker states it, inches; null if metric or unknown
columns.pcb_l_mm: altimeter: PCB length, mm (exact x25.4 conversion of pcb_l_in, 3 dp, where an inch value exists)
columns.pcb_w_mm: altimeter: PCB width, mm (exact conversion, 3 dp)
columns.l_tol_mm: plus-tolerance the sled/pocket template must ADD to the length, mm (uncertainty of the stated value plus wrap/overhang); 0 only if the value is maker-published and verified
columns.w_tol_mm: plus-tolerance to add to the width, mm
columns.h_tol_mm: plus-tolerance to add to the height/thickness, mm
columns.outline_is_envelope: altimeter: true if pcb_l/pcb_w are an ENVELOPE (approximate, +/- l_tol) and must not be used to generate a bolt pattern; false if a maker-stated board outline
columns.pcb_t_mm: altimeter: PCB thickness, mm (for edge-slot capture); typical FR4 1.6 unless stated
columns.height_in: altimeter: overall height as the maker states it in inches, if inch-based; else null
columns.height_mm: altimeter: overall bare-board height INCLUDING the PCB thickness, from the underside of the PCB to the tallest top-side component (terminal blocks / USB / battery connector), mm, excluding standoffs and excluding bottom-side protrusion (see underside_h_mm)
columns.height_basis: altimeter: how height_mm was obtained ('maker overall height', 'recall of tallest component', etc.)
columns.underside_h_mm: altimeter: protrusion of bottom-side components / solder tails below the PCB underside, mm; null = unknown -> template must use standoffs >= 4 mm
columns.hole_count: altimeter: number of mounting holes; null = unknown
columns.hole_dia_mm: altimeter: mounting hole diameter, mm; null = unknown
columns.hole_dx_mm: altimeter: hole centre-to-centre spacing along the board LENGTH, mm; null = unknown -> template falls back to slots
columns.hole_dy_mm: altimeter: hole centre-to-centre spacing along the board WIDTH, mm; null = unknown (or n/a for 2-hole centre-line patterns)
columns.hole_offset_l_mm: altimeter: distance from the board end to the nearest hole centre, mm; null = unknown (assume pattern centred on outline only if hole_pattern_centred_assumed is true)
columns.hole_offset_w_mm: altimeter: distance from the board side to the nearest hole centre, mm; null = unknown
columns.hole_pattern_centred_assumed: altimeter: true if the offsets above are NOT known and the template may only assume the pattern is centred on the outline (unverified assumption)
columns.hole_fastener: altimeter: fastener the hole is sized for, text (e.g. '#2-56 / M2.5'); null = unknown
columns.hole_verified: altimeter: true ONLY if the hole pattern was read from a maker drawing or measured; false otherwise -> template must use slots or +0.5 mm oversize and require a measured board
columns.hole_confidence: altimeter: confidence of the hole fields alone: certain | likely | recall | null (no hole data)
columns.outline_confidence: altimeter: confidence of pcb_l/pcb_w alone: certain | likely | recall
columns.mass_g: mass in grams (altimeter: bare board, no battery; battery: single cell or pack); null = unknown
columns.supply_v_min: altimeter: minimum operating supply voltage, V (numeric)
columns.supply_v_max: altimeter: maximum operating supply voltage, V (numeric)
columns.supply_note: altimeter: battery scheme in words (recommended battery, one- vs two-battery, charger)
columns.pyro_channels: altimeter: number of independent pyro/deployment outputs
columns.pyro_v_max: altimeter: maximum voltage on a separate pyro/deployment battery input, V; null if no separate input or unknown
columns.min_coupler_id_mm: altimeter: smallest coupler the MAKER says the board is designed for, mm (nominal airframe size as the maker words it); null if maker does not state
columns.antenna_len_mm: altimeter: length of the wire radio antenna that must run inside the bay, mm; null if none
columns.min_bay_len_mm: altimeter: minimum interior av-bay length the maker recommends, mm; null if not stated
columns.connector_edge: altimeter: which edge(s) carry terminal blocks / connectors and where the data port is, text; null = not recalled
columns.l_mm: battery: length (longest dimension) of the BARE cell/pack as the size code or standard gives it, mm
columns.h_mm: battery: thickness / height, mm (LiPo: bare pouch thickness from the size code; add h_tol_mm for wrap)
columns.lead_allow_mm: battery: extra length to reserve at the lead/connector/snap end, mm
columns.least_certain_field: the single field in this row a designer should distrust most
columns.disputed: list of alternative values proposed by reviewers where reviewers disagreed with each other; empty list if none
columns.confidence: row confidence = the LOWEST confidence of any numeric field in the row: certain | likely | recall
columns.source: standard or document the values come from

notes: READ BEFORE USING. (1) SCOPE: this table is an EDITABLE-DEFAULTS source for the av-sled template, never a cut sheet. Every altimeter row is 'recall' at row level because no hole pattern is verified (hole_verified=false on all rows); the three Altus Metrum outlines and coupler sizes, EasyMega/EasyTimer outlines, and the 9 V / 9 V lithium / CR123A envelopes are 'likely' (read from the maker manual or a standard). (2) HOLES: the template must read hole_count/hole_dia_mm/hole_dx_mm/hole_dy_mm as numbers and, wherever any is null or hole_verified is false, generate SLOTS (or +0.5 mm oversize holes) and require a measured board before cutting. Never generate a fixed 4-hole pattern from hole_verified=false data. Hole offsets from the board edge are unknown for every board (hole_offset_* null); where hole_pattern_centred_assumed is true the only available assumption is that the pattern is centred on the outline. Fastener labels were made consistent with hole diameters (a #4-40 needs >= 3.2 mm; 2.4 mm is #2 clearance; 2.8 mm is between #2 clearance and #4 major dia and therefore carries no fastener label). (3) HEIGHT: height_mm = overall bare-board height including the PCB; add h_tol_mm, then add the standoff. Template parameter STANDOFF_MM default 6.35 (1/4 in nylon), minimum 4 mm because underside_h_mm is unknown (null) for every board; also add clearance for terminal-block screwdriver access and wire bend radius (~10 mm above terminal blocks). (4) OUTLINE: pcb_l_mm/pcb_w_mm are exact x25.4 conversions of the maker's inch figure (3 dp) -- the precision is the conversion's, not a measurement's; ALWAYS add l_tol_mm/w_tol_mm. Rows with outline_is_envelope=true (Eggtimer Quantum, Proton) are envelopes, not outlines. Overhang of connectors past the board edge (JST-PH, USB shells, Raven terminal block: commonly 1-2 mm) is NOT included in pcb_l/pcb_w; l_tol_mm on those rows is sized to cover it. (5) BATTERIES: 9 V and CR123A envelopes are IEC maxima. LiPo rows are ENVELOPE CLASSES of non-standard commercial packs -- the same mAh from another vendor differs by several mm and connector; the template must force the designer to enter the pack actually bought, and pockets must leave l_tol/w_tol/h_tol plus lead_allow_mm and a strap, never a press-fit. LiPo l/w/h are bare pouch dims from the six-digit size code TT WW LL (thickness 0.1 mm, width mm, length mm); h_tol_mm=2 covers wrap and tab fold. (6) VOLTAGE COMPATIBILITY is to be computed from supply_v_min/supply_v_max, not from prose. Rule used: supply_v_min >= 4.0 V -> a 1S LiPo (3.7 V nominal, 3.0 V cutoff) is NOT a valid main battery: alt_eggtimer_proton, alt_perfectflite_stratologgercf; 3.7 < supply_v_min < 4.0 -> 1S is valid per the maker but MARGINAL (a nearly-flat cell can brown it out; fly a freshly charged cell): alt_featherweight_raven4; supply_v_min <= 3.7 -> 1S valid. TeleMetrum/TeleMega/EasyMega computer supply is 1S LiPo ONLY (3.7-4.2 V); TeleMega/EasyMega accept a separate pyro battery to 16 V (pyro_v_max). Quantum is single-battery by default with an optional second deployment battery (reviewers disagree whether the default single battery is 1S or 2S/9 V -- see disputed).
